project.name: RelayOps Audit Assistant Content Engine
project.description: Build an 8-week launch-oriented content engine for the Audit Assistant release.

planningThread.title: RelayOps Audit Assistant content launch planning

plannerRecommendationGate.description: The planner keeps the thread in discovery or blueprint until the required business anchors are explicit enough to justify moving into task_mapping.
missingContextBehavior: call out the missing requirement by name
ask for the relevant uploaded file or explicit KPI target
do not recommend task generation yet

reviewGate.description: Tasks may enter IN_REVIEW, but the reviewer sends them back if the expected artifact is missing or too weak.

contextManifest.purpose: Ground the messaging matrix and approved terminology.
Anchor scope, audience, launch timing, and KPI target.
Ground the pain language and buying triggers in customer evidence.
Select topic clusters and priority search terms.
Differentiate the launch narrative from competitor content patterns.
Choose a realistic cadence and channel mix based on prior performance.
Ensure the content plan addresses the objections heard in pipeline conversations.

successCriteria: The project reaches task_mapping with explicit audience, message, KPI target, and launch window.
Seven deterministic tasks are generated and begin in TODO.
The task 'Draft 3 priority content briefs' has enough artifact evidence to survive reviewer scrutiny.
The KPI tracker task can be blocked and later restored through the app's actual status lifecycle.

generatedTasks.title: Define target audience and launch success metrics
generatedTasks.description: Confirm the primary buyer, supporting stakeholders, and the launch KPI target for the eight-week content engine.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary audience is named with company-size and role context.
Secondary stakeholders are listed.
The 45 assisted demo request KPI is explicit with a measurement window and owner.

generatedTasks.title: Approve the launch messaging matrix
generatedTasks.description: Translate the approved positioning into a launch messaging matrix with proof pillars and objection handling.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary message is final.
Three proof pillars are documented.
At least three major objections are mapped to response themes.

generatedTasks.title: Select topic clusters and SEO priorities
generatedTasks.description: Choose the launch topic clusters and search opportunities that support the approved message architecture.
acceptanceCriteria: Three topic clusters are selected.
Priority keywords are named for each cluster.
The rationale ties search demand back to the launch narrative.

generatedTasks.title: Build the 8-week editorial calendar
generatedTasks.description: Turn the approved clusters into an eight-week calendar with one primary asset per week and clear ownership.
acceptanceCriteria: Eight weekly rows are present.
Each row names an owner, format, channel, and CTA.
The cadence stays within the launch-team production constraints.

generatedTasks.title: Draft 3 priority content briefs
generatedTasks.description: Produce execution-ready briefs for the operations-risk, audit-readiness, and compliance-ROI assets.
acceptanceCriteria: Three briefs exist.
Each brief includes audience, angle, target keyword, CTA, and SME needs.
The briefs explicitly address at least one sales objection or customer pain pattern.

generatedTasks.title: Create the distribution checklist by channel
generatedTasks.description: Define launch distribution steps for website, email, webinar, social, and sales handoff.
acceptanceCriteria: Each channel has an owner.
Each channel has required asset dependencies.
Sales handoff is explicitly included.

generatedTasks.title: Define KPI tracker and reporting cadence
generatedTasks.description: Define the KPI tracker and reporting rhythm for the eight-week content engine.
acceptanceCriteria: Primary KPI target is explicit.
Supporting metrics are named.
Owners and reporting cadence are included.

representativeTaskLifecycle.reviewFailureMode: The reviewer sends the task back from IN_REVIEW to IN_PROGRESS if fewer than three briefs are present or if the briefs do not show audience, angle, CTA, and SME support.
